## WarpSpeed

The camera jumps to light speed: star streaks shoot out from the center and stretch longer and longer while the outgoing image is pulled into a radial smear, then after a flash the incoming image emerges from the center as the streaks shrink back

- Tags: zoom, radial, light, motion-blur, space
- Parameters:
  - `center` (vec2 = vec2(0.5, 0.5)): Point the camera flies toward, from (0, 0) at the bottom left to (1, 1) at the top right
  - `streaks` (float = 160) [range 20 to 400]: Number of star streaks around the center
  - `streakColor` (vec4 = vec4(0.78, 0.88, 1, 1)) [color]: Color of the streaks and of the flash, added as light
  - `strength` (float = 0.6) [range 0 to 1]: Length of the streaks and of the radial smear
  - `flash` (float = 0.5) [range 0 to 1]: Brightness of the flash at the peak of the jump
- Author: gre
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/transitions/WarpSpeed.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/sksl/WarpSpeed.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/WarpSpeed

## WaterDrop

A drop falls into the image like into still water: round ripples spread out from where it hits, bending the image with glints on their slopes, the incoming image shows up inside the leading ripple, and the water calms down

- Tags: ripple, water, refraction, circle
- Parameters:
  - `amplitude` (float = 30) [range 10 to 80]: Frequency of the ripples: higher makes them closer together
  - `speed` (float = 30) [range 0 to 80]: Speed of the ripples as they run outward through the spreading rings
  - `center` (vec2 = vec2(0.5, 0.5)): Where the drop falls, in texture coordinates
  - `refraction` (float = 0.015) [range 0 to 0.08]: How far the ripples bend the image, in frame heights
  - `highlight` (float = 0.5) [range 0 to 1]: Brightness of the glints on the ripples
- Author: Paweł Płóciennik
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/transitions/WaterDrop.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/sksl/WaterDrop.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/WaterDrop

## WaveWipe

A breaking wave crashes across the frame, its lip curling over in front of its face and throwing foam and spray ahead, its shadow darkening the outgoing image; the incoming image is left behind it, tinted and bent by the water, clearing as the wave passes

- Tags: water, wave, ocean, foam, directional, reveal
- Parameters:
  - `direction` (vec2 = vec2(1, 0)): Direction the wave travels toward
  - `curl` (float = 0.3) [range 0.1 to 0.45]: Size of the curling lip, in wave heights: how far it overhangs ahead of the face
  - `foam` (float = 0.6) [range 0 to 1]: Amount of foam on the crest and spray thrown ahead of it
  - `refraction` (float = 0.04) [range 0 to 0.1]: How much the water bends the incoming image behind the wave
  - `water` (vec4 = vec4(0.05, 0.36, 0.46, 0.75)) [color]: Color of the water tinting the incoming image behind the wave (its alpha is its strength)
  - `foamColor` (vec4 = vec4(1, 1, 1, 1)) [color]: Color of the foam and spray (its alpha is its strength)
- Author: gre
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/transitions/WaveWipe.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/sksl/WaveWipe.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/WaveWipe

## WedgeWipe

Two hands sweep away from each other around the center, opening a widening wedge that reveals the incoming image

- Tags: wipe, radial, clock, wedge
- Parameters:
  - `angle` (float = 0) [range -180 to 180]: Direction the wedge opens from, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock
  - `smoothness` (float = 0.01) [range 0 to 0.2]: Softness of the hands' edges
  - `center` (vec2 = vec2(0.5, 0.5)): Point the hands turn around
- Author: gre
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/transitions/WedgeWipe.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/sksl/WedgeWipe.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/WedgeWipe

## WhipPan

A fast camera pan that streaks both images with motion blur, the incoming one arriving from the opposite side

- Tags: slide, motion-blur, directional
- Parameters:
  - `direction` (vec2 = vec2(-1, 0)): Direction in which the images move
  - `blur` (float = 0.4) [range 0 to 1]: Length of the motion blur at full speed
- Author: gre
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/transitions/WhipPan.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/sksl/WhipPan.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/WhipPan

## WhipSpin

The camera rolls faster and faster around the center of the frame, streaking the outgoing image in a spin blur, then the incoming one takes over mid-spin and slows to a stop

- Tags: rotate, motion-blur, spin
- Parameters:
  - `turns` (float = 1) [range -3 to 3]: Total rotation, in turns, split between the two images (negative turns clockwise)
  - `blur` (float = 0.5) [range 0 to 1]: Length of the motion blur along the spin
  - `chroma` (float = 0.6) [range 0 to 1]: How much the color channels split apart as the spin speeds up
  - `zoom` (float = 0.25) [range 0 to 1]: How much the camera zooms in at the fastest point
- Author: gre
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/transitions/WhipSpin.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/sksl/WhipSpin.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/WhipSpin

## WhipTilt

The camera tilts fast from the outgoing image to the incoming one, set edge to edge at an angle above it, streaking both in perspective with a vertical motion blur

- Tags: 3d, rotate, motion-blur, vertical
- Parameters:
  - `down` (bool = false): Tilt the camera down to an incoming image below instead of above
  - `blur` (float = 0.5) [range 0 to 1]: Length of the motion blur along the tilt
  - `chroma` (float = 0.5) [range 0 to 1]: How much the color channels split apart as the tilt speeds up
  - `perspective` (float = 0.7) [range 0 to 1]: Strength of the perspective (field of view of the camera)
- Author: gre
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/transitions/WhipTilt.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@3.3.0/sksl/WhipTilt.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/WhipTilt

## Wind

A ragged left-to-right wipe, as if the image was blown away by the wind

- Tags: wipe, horizontal, noise
- Parameters:
  - `size` (float = 0.2) [range 0 to 1]: Width of the ragged edge
  - `reversed` (bool = false): Wipe from right to left instead
